summary: MeiliSearch is a full-text search engine that provides instant, typo-tolerant query responses via an API. It is designed to be integrated into applications to deliver fast search results as users type. The project is open-source under the MIT licence and written in Rust.
goodFor: Developers looking to add fast, typo-tolerant search capabilities to their applications without the operational complexity of larger search ecosystems.
watchOut: You will need to manage index storage and memory consumption carefully as your dataset grows, and ensure your queries do not exceed available hardware resources during peak traffic.
deployNotes: It typically runs via Docker or native packages, requiring persistent storage volumes for your search indices and a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
